svg.text: Exactly three role lanes • Independent workflow sub-channels • Specification versus current code • 1 November 2026
SOURCE: Project specification §§1.6, 3.2, 4.4 + current web/mobile composition roots, repositories, API and schema.
READING KEY: Each row is an independent workflow track, not a mandatory journey through all rows. Module badges identify code or named specification modules. Diamonds
are gates; True continues, False follows the explicitly written alternative beneath the diamond. Approval True/False result blocks are alternatives.
DEPLOYMENT BOUNDARIES AND DATA TOUCHPOINTS (infrastructure band; not a fourth role)
Profile UUID matches Supabase user UUID
No favourites / uploads / tour tables here
Browser → API: Authorization: Bearer access_token • API → Supabase: GET /auth/v1/user to validate the user.
Invalid/missing token: 401 • Auth service unavailable: 503 • Catalog pagination: ≤200 rows/page • Unknown property: 404.
Workbook Filtered_Data → prepare-property-workbook.py → ignored .data/properties.json → import-properties.js → PostgreSQL upsert by canonical ID.
2,126 accepted rows; 374 excluded; 2,004 external image URLs. No image-file upload or copying to Supabase Storage.
properties: id, title, address, city, state, postcode, rental_rm, size_sqft, latitude, longitude, property_type, image_url, source_url,
suitability_score, dataset_validation, source_workbook, source_sheet, source_row, source_data JSONB, imported_at.
profiles: user_id UUID, email, display_name, role, created_at. First insert can select owner or
entrepreneur; existing role is preserved. Administrator is assigned by a trusted database operator. UI
route redirects check profile role; catalogue API checks authentication, not per-role catalogue
OTHER REPOSITORY SERVICES — PRESENT IN SOURCE, NOT WIRED TO CURRENT APP LOCATORS

backend/: FastAPI /api/v1 route groups: properties, users, recommendations, suitability, saved-properties, geospatial, virtual-tours, reports. SQLModel repositories/services and ML/explanation source exist;
deployment and app integration are not established by the inspected composition roots. No live app arrows point to these routes.

test/server.js: separate research/map API on :3000 using research data. Current application catalogue uses test/app-server.js on :3001. Shared Dart logic is a library, not a network service; each app owns independent
STATUS: CONNECTED = integrated code path | LOCAL / DEMO = process/device state | BLOCKED = path cannot complete | SPEC = documented target

g.text: Sign in with Google or email
UUID, email, name; existing role preserved
False: redirect to assigned role home
g.title: E01 — Web identity and role access. Signup allows entrepreneur or owner; metadata cannot grant administrator.

g.text: Demo role menu can switch roles
Named routes; no production role API
g.title: E02 — Mobile startup and authentication. Email password length is checked; demo account matching is not real password authentication. Provider login is simulated.

g.text: Profile edits are prototype UI state
Web validates email; sends no reset email
g.title: E03 — Account maintenance and logout. These are independent account actions, not mandatory sequential tasks.

g.text: Text, rent, size, property type, location
Address, rent, area, coordinates, image URL
g.title: E04 — Catalogue search, filters and detail. API verifies bearer token. Imported data is not proof of current availability or administrator verification.

g.text: Budget, floor area, location, property type
False: exclude candidate; empty results possible
g.title: E05 — Preferences and current shortlist. Mobile uses RecommendationRepositoryImpl demo filtering/ranking. Preferences are not saved to PostgreSQL.

g.text: Module: Data Processing and Geospatial Intelligence
Not invoked by either current app locator
Specification target, not current index sort
g.title: E06 — Documented AI scoring and history. Specification processing-failure and no-suitable-property alternatives are required; current web shortlist is not this AI pipeline.
E07 — Geospatial data preparation. These source retrievals are independent inputs to E08; order here follows UC106. They are not live web computations.

g.text: Specification target; mobile uses demo data
g.title: E08 — Spatial indicators and explanation. True path describes the specification. Web does not fabricate competitor, demand or contribution values.
E09 — Map exploration and spatial layers. Specification also requires map-load error handling and location-corresponding overlays. Mobile uses SitewiseMapPanel prototype.
E10 — Save, view and remove favourites. Web selections survive only in current browser session; mobile selections are AppCubit state. No persistent favourites endpoint is wired.

g.text: False: adding fourth property is ignored
g.title: E11 — Compare property alternatives. Comparison does not create a persisted assessment, prediction, or database record.

g.text: Local/demo media; imported records have no tour
g.title: E12 — Approved virtual-tour viewing. Approval gate exists in shared code. No mobile-to-web media synchronization or storage upload is connected.
E13 — Location evaluation report. Web report depends on missing analysis and may remain at “Generating report”; it does not produce a complete live analysis.

g.text: Specification lists scope; no invented events
g.title: E14 — Extended business-assessment modules. Inventory blocks are parallel named modules, not a claimed executable sequence. Detailed ordering is not established by the inspected source.

g.text: Sign in with Google or email
UUID, email, name; existing role preserved
False: redirect to assigned role home
g.title: O01 — Web identity and owner access. New profile may select owner. Owner identity does not link imported workbook rows to that account.

g.text: Demo role menu can switch roles
Named routes; no production role API
g.title: O02 — Mobile onboarding and owner entry. Mobile owner scope is DemoData.demoOwnerId; demo role switching is not production authorization.

g.text: Web: empty list; mobile: demo owner rows
g.title: O03 — Owner dashboard and listing status. Web ApiPropertyRepository.getPropertiesByOwner returns []; imported records carry empty ownerId.

g.text: Mobile currently confirms and returns; no write
g.title: O04 — Add and update commercial listing. Specification requires validated data storage. The final mobile confirmation is not persisted listing creation.

g.text: False: retain listing; return to management
g.title: O05 — Property images and deletion. True paths describe the specification only. Existing catalogue uses external image URLs; no Supabase Storage upload occurs.
O06 — Submit listing and observe review. Event L1: pending listing can enter administrator queue within the same mobile process. No HTTP submission API exists.

g.text: On-device paths and ordered frame indices
Tour draft and captured frame list
g.title: O07 — Capture panorama frames on mobile. Native camera, AR and stitching require hands-on device verification. Web has no capture implementation.

g.text: False: insufficient or duplicate frame error
Missing or invalid file: preserve source frames
False: explain failure; retry / retake frames
Record output path; local tour metadata
g.title: O08 — Validate and stitch panorama. Output is local media plus in-memory tour state; there is no backend upload or inter-device sharing.

g.text: Mobile uses stored frames; web has zero frames
g.title: O09 — Preview, regenerate and submit tour. Event T1: pendingTours() exposes submission to admin within same repository instance. No upload API is called.

g.text: Mobile hook; web has no frame files
g.title: O10 — Delete virtual tour. Specification says authorized owner may delete an unpublished tour; current shared service itself does not enforce an unpublished-only guard.

g.text: Web form state; no profile update endpoint
Does not persist edited profile fields
Web: Supabase; mobile: delete local session
g.title: O11 — Owner profile and session maintenance. Password reset is disabled on web. Owner profile editing is not database account management.

g.text: Sign in with Google or email
UUID, email, name; existing role preserved
False: redirect to assigned role home
g.title: A01 — Administrator authentication and access. Only a trusted local database operator assigns admin in sitewise_app.profiles; self-service signup cannot do so.

g.text: Demo role menu can switch roles
Named routes; no production role API
g.title: A02 — Mobile administrator demo entry. Admin mobile routes are demo workflows; role menu switches AppCubit state.

g.text: Web properties live; account list demo
g.title: A03 — Dashboard and listing oversight. Dataset quality PASS is not admin approval. Activity/monitoring displays are not a durable audit log.

g.text: Mobile local mutation; web read-only error
Mobile local mutation; web read-only error
g.title: A04 — Review, approve or reject listing. Branches are alternatives, not sequential approvals. Reason is passed but not persisted by PropertyRepository; no email or notification is sent.

g.text: Service exists; admin removal UI not established
g.title: A05 — Review and moderate virtual tours. Event T2: approved and published tour resolves through entrepreneur visibility gate in same app instance. No cross-device propagation.

g.text: Name, email, role, status, joined date
Specification requirement; no connected write API
g.title: A06 — Account inspection and management. The administrator user list is separate from live sitewise_app.profiles; it is not a view of Supabase Auth users.

g.text: No registered admin monitoring route identified
g.title: A07 — Recommendation monitoring. No prediction monitoring API is invoked by the current administrator app.
A08 — Explanation monitoring. Existing explanation backend source is not an application integration.

g.text: Web save sets local confirmation state
Supabase logout or local session deletion
g.title: A09 — Administrator profile and logout. No automatic administrator approval, privilege escalation or trusted-role assignment UI is implemented.

svg.text: CROSS-ROLE INTERSECTIONS — DASHED EVENTS; NO INVENTED HTTP ENDPOINTS
Mobile in-memory property repository only; web write is blocked.
L2 A04 → O06: verify(id) / reject(id, reason) → owner status lookup
Local status mutation only; reason is not stored and no notification is sent.
Same app TourRepositoryImpl instance; no network event or webhook.
Only approved AND published tours resolve. No mobile ↔ web synchronization.

SPECIFICATION HANDOFF: owner submits content → administrator reviews → owner receives updated status → entrepreneur sees approved content. This is not an integrated deployed workflow. Dashed L/T buses above show only
the actual same-instance shared-service behavior; there is no submission HTTP API, notification webhook or cross-device media transport.

Authoritative specification: RSW_JOELTANHOUJUN_Project1.pdf, §§1.6, 3.2.1, 4.4.1–4.4.9. Current implementation takes precedence over older repository audit claims. Required-but-unconnected modules are kept visible
rather than depicted as deployed components. Parallel source retrievals and independent account actions are explicitly labelled in the companion ledger.

See sitewise-master-workflows.json and sitewise-master-architecture-notes.md for every track note, exact branch interpretation, source paths and known UI limitations. This artifact describes code and requirements; it
does not certify live deployment, security completeness, model performance or successful device tests.
